POST /callback/:id: Provider callbacks that post their answer (form_post).
GET /get-session: The browser reads its own session.
POST /get-session: The same read, as Better Auth's client may send it.
POST /sign-up/email: Password sign-up, behind an invitation or owner grant (auth.ts hooks).
POST /sign-in/social: Starts a provider sign-in through its redirect; ID tokens are refused.
POST /update-session: Better Auth session refresh; carries no credential change.
POST /update-user: Name and image only: emailVerified is stripped by user.update.before.
POST /delete-user: Off by Better Auth's default (deleteUser.enabled unset): answers 404 before reading a password.
POST /revoke-session: Ends one of the account's own sessions.
POST /revoke-sessions: Ends all of the account's own sessions.
POST /link-social: Settings link of a provider to the signed-in account (link-gate.ts).
GET /list-accounts: The signed-in account's own sign-in methods.
GET /delete-user/callback: Off with deleteUser: no deletion token is ever issued.
POST /unlink-account: Removes one of the account's own provider sign-ins.
GET /error: Better Auth's error page for a failed redirect.
